dialogue.speaker: Tom Miller
dialogue.text: Hello Alex. We are building a nationwide directory of artisanal sourdough bakeries. The core feature is allowing bakeries to sign up online and pay a monthly subscription fee of 49 pounds sterling via Stripe.

dialogue.speaker: Alex Rivera
dialogue.text: Brilliant Directories natively integrates with Stripe. We will configure your Stripe Payment Gateway credentials, set up the monthly recurring product tier, and enable automatic webhooks for renewal processing.

dialogue.speaker: Tom Miller
dialogue.text: Our domain is artisanbakers.co.uk. We have pointed nameservers, but we need an active SSL certificate so members see the padlock and https everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: Alex Rivera
dialogue.text: Brilliant Directories includes free Let's Encrypt SSL certificates. Once nameserver propagation is verified, we will generate and activate the SSL certificate directly in the admin panel.

dialogue.speaker: Tom Miller
dialogue.text: We also want our social media channels linked in the site footer: Instagram, Facebook, and a YouTube baking tutorial channel.

dialogue.speaker: Alex Rivera
dialogue.text: We will configure the Social Media tab in General Settings with your respective profile URLs and verified icon font display.

dialogue.speaker: Tom Miller
dialogue.text: Our deadline for this portal is December 1, 2026 in time for the holiday season.

dialogue.speaker: Alex Rivera
dialogue.text: December 1, 2026 is confirmed. We will draft the full scope and estimate based on these requirements.
